build_fuse_gmock: build fused Google Mock and Google Test files into a single output directory
create_fused_gmock_h: create a fused gmock/gmock.h header file from Google Mock source code
create_fused_gtest_h: create a fused gtest/gtest.h header file from Google Test source code
create_fused_gmock_gtest_all_cc: create a fused gmock-gtest-all.cc source file combining Google Mock and Google Test
run_fuse_gmock_cli: run the fuse_gmock_files.py CLI to generate fused gtest and gmock files
